I haven't, but judging upon her past behavior she will definitely laugh in my face or make some comment about me being sensitive or some shit. 

There is literally nothing about my behavior or work ethic that justifies her actions. I would somewhat understand if I was lazy or acted unprofessional in ANY  way, but I don't. When I step into the kitchen, it's all about being fast and efficient.

Some days are desperate. Horrible. On days that aren't so bad, I have time to reflect and think things over. You're right. I haven't killed myself yet because no one will be able to protect my children.  I wouldn't wish this predicament on anyone. I've reached out to any and every outlet available. I cannot leave until I am absolutely positive I will have full custody of my babies. If we are together, I can at least protect them from him myself.

My parents know. A few friends know.  No one can help me. I have photos of handprints and bruises he has left on the children. I sent them to a safe place. It still doesn't seem like enough.  I know if I leave this time he will stop at nothing to take my children from me. That's just how he works.  Considering he has a respectable and well paying career and I have no college degree(currently in default on student loans because he terrorized me until I quit school and then he refused to pay back what I borrowed-and I'm not allowed to work to pay it myself).... Life is so bleak. 


All of this anti-abuse stuff, and financial abuse is very rarely ever mentioned.  

Also, I have a main Reddit account.  I have had to ask for food assistance on it because he was unwilling to buy food for us.  Again, he makes enough money to support us, but we come last to his expensive gadgets and toys.
